text:
incident-bot: ALERT P1 — spike in 5xx (504/502) from private egress gateway in us-west-2. Rate ~18% for customer-private routes. Auto-page sent to #incidents and on-call.

Dave_oncall: seeing it, joining. first check: is this across all private clusters or a subset?

Maria_sre: looks concentrated to routes that go via transit-gw -> nat-shadow-1 (private egress cluster). Public-hosted flows and dedicated instances unaffected.

Josh_net: I already pulled flow logs. lots of `TCP RST` and `connect timeout` from nat-shadow-1->internet-gw. possible SNAT port exhaustion or security group drop.

Carol_prod: customers reporting 504s hitting Redwood API via private path. Ticket from AcmeCorp and FinApps. severity P1. Carol, can you confirm list?

Sean_support: Confirmed 6 active customer reports referencing gateway timeouts around 15:02-15:10 UTC. Escalating to account team.

Dave_oncall: quick triage steps: 1) are there recent infra changes? 2) nat instance metrics (established sockets, ephemeral ports) 3) SG or route changes?

Deploy-bot: Rollout completed: `infra/nat-shadow` revision 2026-03-15T14:58 by @infra-deploy. No other infra rollouts in last hour.

Maria_sre: suspicious — deploy-bot shows a config change to `conntrack` tune and new iptables rule to drop SYNs from blackhole range. Could have regressed conntrack behaviour.

Josh_net: pulling conntrack stats from nat-shadow-1: `conntrack -S` shows entries at 1.2M, limit 1.5M; TIME_WAIT high. ephemeral port usage near 65k on a subset of IPs.

Dave_oncall: run `ss -s` on nat-shadow-1 and paste top lines.

Josh_net: `ss -s` output: "TCP: total 1200000 (estab 34000, closed 1160000, orphaned 0, timewait 900000)" — timewait huge.

Maria_sre: that pattern + conntrack change could cause new outbound flows to fail and return 504s from gateway. Possibly the iptables change reduced reuse of TIME_WAIT ports.

Carol_prod: any quick mitigation we can do without full rollback? Customers are impacted.

Dave_oncall: options: a) rollback nat-shadow config (risky if we haven't validated across regions) b) scale out nat-shadow (add more egress IPs/NAT instances) c) modify route table to failover private-prefix to standby public egress cluster for affected accounts.

Infra-lead: if we can fail traffic to standby quickly that's lowest-risk. We'll need route table update + ACL allow.

Josh_net: I can add a route to the private route table for the affected subnets pointing to nat-standby-1. Doing a dry-run to ensure SG on standby allows traffic.

Dave_oncall: Carol, prepare customer-facing note: "We're routing private egress to standby gateways to mitigate increased timeouts; minimal/no app changes needed". Keep it short.

Carol_prod: drafting: "We are mitigating an egress networking issue by rerouting traffic through a standby gateway. You may see transient retries; we expect improvement within 10 minutes. We'll follow up with root cause." Will send once I have a timestamp.

Josh_net: route change applied to 3 affected route tables at 15:20 UTC. Confirming connectivity with `curl` to internal health check via private path.

Dave_oncall: run: ```
curl -sS -D - 'https://internal-gw.private.redwood/api/v1/health' -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n'
```

Josh_net: before reroute: `504` -> after reroute: `200`. Latency down to ~40ms.

Incident-bot: NOTE: synthetic monitors show 5xx rate from private routes drop from 18% -> 2% after 15:24 UTC.

Sean_support: updating customer tickets: pushed Carol's message and note to scheduled status update. Customers acknowledged, some on call asked for timeline.

Maria_sre: mitigation successful for now, but we need RCA. We should collect: conntrack dumps, iptables config diff from pre-rollout, deploy artifact, traffic distribution, and per-src-port histogram.

Josh_net: grabbing artifacts: `scp nat-shadow-1:/var/log/conntrack-dump-2315123.log .` and `iptables-save > /tmp/iptables-before-after.diff` — attaching to incident timeline.

Dave_oncall: escalate to infra-lead to decide rollback vs code fix. Infra-lead, recommend rollback of the conntrack tweak and re-run test in staging; but don't rollback live until we have a planned window.

Infra-lead: agree. Don't rollback live. Postmortem: 1) revert change in repo, 2) add canary for conntrack, 3) increase NAT pool or tweak TIME_WAIT reuse. For immediate safety, leave routes pointed to standby and throttle deploys to nat-shadow.

Deploy-bot: Blocked: `infra/nat-shadow` deploys have been temporarily paused by SRE at 15:32 UTC.

Maria_sre: adding short-term engineering tasks: - produce script to rotate ephemeral ports on nat instances - add metrics for TIME_WAIT per instance - add guardrail to fail deploy if conntrack param changed without canary.

Carol_prod: customer update sent at 15:35 UTC: "We've rerouted traffic to standby gateways; error rates are dropping. We'll provide a post-incident report within 24 hours."

Sean_support: customers on lock-step: AcmeCorp requested an incident bridge for deeper logs; scheduled at 15:45 UTC.

Dave_oncall: preparing incident handoff in 30min to night on-call. Key artifacts: conntrack dumps, iptables diff, deploy revision 2026-03-15T14:58, route table diff, customer ticket IDs.

Maria_sre: I'll own the RCA doc. Putting pointer to S3 `s3://redwood-incidents/2315123456/` with collected artifacts. (will populate after incident)

Josh_net: one more note: we saw higher-than-normal SYN retries from a handful of source IPs (likely a downstream client retry loop) that may have exacerbated ephemeral port usage. Need to correlate with app retries.

Dave_oncall: Handoff summary for night shift: 1) mitigation in place (traffic to nat-standby) 2) root cause suspected: conntrack/iptables change in nat-shadow causing TIME_WAIT/non-reuse of ephemeral ports -> outbound port exhaustion -> 504s 3) next steps: keep routes on standby, block further nat-shadow deploys, infra-lead to approve revert in staging + canary, customers notified.

Infra-lead: acknowledged. If error rate creeps back above 5% re-open paging.

Carol_prod: final note to customers logged. Closing live bridge at 15:58 UTC once confirm monitors stable for 15m.

Dave_oncall: closing live mitigation window. Leaving thread for RCA and postmortem. Handoff to @maria_sre for follow-ups and @infra-lead for rollback planning.

incident-bot: Incident P1 status -> mitigated. Create postmortem task assigned to @maria_sre and @infra-lead.

Maria_sre: accepted. Will produce draft RCA in 12 hours and full postmortem within 48 hours.
